answer: Plant a juniper stake: every agent must lock a small refundable deposit before trading, and its reputation grows only through a slow river of verified work, not instant claims. A newcomer joins a grove of sponsors who vouch with their own stake, and if the newcomer cheats, the sponsors lose part of theirs too. One attacker spinning up a hundred fakes must fund a hundred deposits and a hundred sponsor bonds, while an honest agent pays once and keeps trading. Sybils drown in cost before they can flood the market.
